_comment: Which rail each capacitor sits on, and what that rail runs at.
The rated voltage is NOT here -- it is read from the parts list
at run time, so a corrected BOM corrects this too.
source: 'schematic' means the net was traced on the Chapter 7
sheet cited in the note; 'inferred' means it was deduced from
the rails present at that slot and has not been read off a
schematic. appliedV: null means the rail was never traced --
shown as unknown rather than assumed safe.
railClass is how much energy is behind the rail, which decides
what a shorted part does: A is an unfused 3 A rail with a
6600 uF reservoir, C is fused, E is a floating common.
Generated by tools/import_cap_audit.py; hand edits are kept.

C2.note: Across VR2, mirror of C1. Sheet 1 of 3. NOT on -44S.

C14.note: P502-32/31; sheet 1 of 3. | LT1033CK 3A, UNFUSED, 6600uF on -17SR

C48.net: VREF at U30 pin 3, through R32 (120 ohm) — DC SENSE BUFFER
C48.note: CORRECTED 2026-08 by the tantalum audit. Was 'inferred' on the +15S rail; it is not on a rail at all. Traced on Figure 7-14 sheet 2 of 3 (Ch7 PDF page 57), in the block captioned DC SENSE BUFFER: VREF comes in, passes through R32 (120 ohm) and lands on U30 pin 3, the non-inverting input of the 1007 buffer; C48 (4.7 uF, '+' plate on the signal node) filters that node to common. C49 and C50 are the ones on +15 and -15 either side of U30, not this. VREF is a signal, not a supply: it is the DAC assembly's output brought in on DAC/OSC OUT HI and selected by K1, so it tracks the programmed amplitude -- 3.16 V dc at 1 V rms / 1 kHz per S5-17 step 1 (TP3), and 6.5 V during internal calibration when K1 switches in A11's BRF6/BSRF6 reference. In service this part therefore sits at a few volts. 15 V is kept as the recorded value because it is the hard bound the node cannot pass -- U30's own +15 supply -- and because the DAC's output range does not reach it. 60 % of a 25 V part at that bound, well under half at any operating value. The number did not change; what changed is that it is now a traced bound on the right node instead of an inferred rail on the wrong one.

C40.note: VR3 anode / R16 junction, Q3 emitter supply. +9.9 V nominal, +10.7 V with +15 OSC at its +800 mV limit. Sheet 1 zone D2.

C41.note: Q4 (MPSH10) emitter supply, mirror of C40. -10.1 V computed from the R14/R15 bias divider, -10.6 V worst case. Sheet 1 zone C2.

C22.net: Buffer amp output coupling (U3 pin 6 / TP4)
C22.note: AC coupling, not decoupling. Hard-clamped by antiparallel CR1/CR2 (1N4448) on the same node pair, so it can never exceed one diode drop. Sheet 1 zone B5. This is why a 3 V part is correct here.

C25.net: Buffer amp output coupling (U3 pin 6 / TP4)
C25.note: Parallel with C22, same clamp. Sheet 1 zone C5.
